nodes.title: MARS-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory MARS-Seq schematic, interpreted as the single-cell mRNA counting architecture identified with Jaitin et al. (PMID 24531970). One linear path runs from polyadenylated RNA through a labeled DNA intermediate and amplified RNA to a P5/P7 cDNA library. Initial RT, pooling of lysate contents, and the unlabeled in vitro transcription bridge are included only where the supplied text makes them architecturally necessary. This is not a reconstruction of unshown protocol settings or a later MARS-Seq version.
